async def act(page):
    # Click the 'New project' link to navigate to the project creation page
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='New project').click()
    # Wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now on the new project page, fill in the project name
    await page.get_by_label('Project name').fill('web_arena')
    # Set the project visibility to public (assuming a radio button or select)
    # Typically, GitLab has a visibility level selector with options like 'Private', 'Internal', 'Public'
    await page.get_by_label('Visibility level').select_option('public')
    # Add members: first, find the section to add members, then input usernames
    # Assuming there's an input field for adding members
    await page.get_by_placeholder('Add members by username').fill('Abishek')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')  # To add the member
    await page.get_by_placeholder('Add members by username').fill('Vinta')
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    # Click the create project button
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Create project').click()
    # Wait for the project to be created
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
